question: Which substances are employed to purify and honor the goddess after her immersion?
premises: Clay, decoction, water, cow-products, and similar substances are used.
Flowers, leaves, fruits, and waters are also applied.
inference: A range of purifying and auspicious substances is used to treat the goddess after immersion.
plain_english: With clay, decoction, water, cow-products, and so on, and with waters accompanied by flowers, leaves, and fruits...
